_note: case-type-messages-moment-channel: a message template says when it goes out (moment, a case event) and how (channel). The case type page lists a type's messages by them (board DqZaaktype "Berichten aan de aanvrager"). Both are configuration: the events are generic case events, never a procedure's own steps.

moment.title: Moment
moment.description: The case event this message goes out on: the case is received, its status changes, information is requested from the applicant, its term is extended, a decision is made, or the case is closed. Empty: the message is only sent by hand.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: How the message reaches the applicant: the government message box with e-mail as fallback, the message box only, e-mail, the portal, or post.
